import json, re, random, chess, sys, time
R = json.load(open('/tmp/obench-cell-hxjzf05s/bench_opencode_regex-chess_njcmuk_q/re.json'))
def run(fen):
    for p, r in R: fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    b = chess.Board(fen); exp = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); exp.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    if not exp: return True
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen); print(sorted(set(ours)-exp)); print(sorted(exp-set(ours)))
    return ok
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
n=0; t=time.time()
for g in range(300):
    b = chess.Board()
    for ply in range(200):
        if b.is_game_over(): break
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            n+=1
            if not check(b.fen()): sys.exit(1)
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        # prefer captures/promotions sometimes
        b.push(random.choice(ms))
print("ok", n, time.time()-t)
EOF
